notes.title: Patch 18.15 - Reality Shift Difficulty Increase
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Reason why I'm making this new post so soon after last patch is because this is it's own separate changes to experiment if it should stay or revert back to 18.1. This patch is primarily focused towards increasing the difficulty of Reality Shift, and also in turn a feature that is in Most Wanted too. 

Difficulty Increase
After extensively playing the mode, I realised that the difficulty was not that high and you could practically always be back at max health within seconds of shooting a couple of police ships. Therefore, I have made it so you have to shoot 3 ships to recover one segment of health. This makes it much more crucial to focus on enemy ships before shooting through the deities. This will also apply to Most Wanted but obviously, this patch is for testing and if it gets negative feedback, it will be reverted to 18.1 after a couple of days. Another thing to note is the Volcanic Residual has a 2% increased range, and police ships spawn 0.4s faster. The S.E.S Brute also now spawns at 

As a reward, the prize of completing Reality Shift has increased from $17,500  → $27,500

notes.title: No Escape | Patch #18
notes.notes:
Hi all,

My break will still be in effect... I hope! This is the last major content update before I take my break from working on this to start on another game. This update revamps Reality Shift from Patch 17 and adds new twists to the mode. I have also done a few quality of life fixes such as fixing that damn timer! Hope you all enjoy. 

Reality Shift: Gravity Pull
Fight the Reality Deity with a new mechanic to the game, gravity pull. Just like a blackhole, this mechanic pulls you towards the deity, making things much harder. The intensity of the pull is light at a range, and when you get closer, the pull gets more intense. Make use of your boosters and keep your distance from the middle! 

Reality Shift: Volcanic Residual Rework
Compared to the Frozen, Volcanic felt really under-powered in both this mode and even as a Deity. Overall, he was pretty easy to dodge and posed no threat compared to Frozen's abilities. Therefore, he is now equipped with a volcanic flamethrower that is lethal when you're in close proximity, so keep an eye out! To balance this, he has 25% less health than the frozen deity and has a short range attack. 

Player Card
Personally, I really dislike how I've implemented Stats into this game, also requiring you to go into a separate menu to claim achievements based on specific stats. Therefore, your very own player card has made it's way onto the menu! This displays everything the stats menu did, including your current balance, from the comfort of the menu. Certain achievements will also unlock on the menu if you meet the requirements. Hopefully, this is a worthy QoL fix that will make tracking your progress better. 

Money Clicker v1.5
Since I added Money Clicker, rewards for completing modes has soared by over 10 times the amount, and this mode became obsolete. I mean, making $5 every 12 clicks is terrible when one Red Light game earns you $500. Therefore, while it's not a major increase, you can now earn a maximum of $20 every 7 clicks. And, I removed any traces of the anti-cheat that disabled auto-clicker for a couple of people. 

Note that I am planning on making a v2 when I return from my break, with 5 more tiers per upgrade.

notes.title: The Deities Update: Reality | Patch #17
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Before I take my long break from this game, I felt like adding one more final content update for the time being. This finalises my original idea of the trio of deities. In Patch 9, I introduced the volcanic deity and his knights. In Patch 10, I introduced the frozen deity and his icicle spears. 7 major patches later, I bring you the Reality Deity, specific for the Most Wanted's new mode, Reality Shift and the residuals of Volcanic and Frozen.

New Mode: Reality Shift
Added as a Most Wanted expansion, Reality Shift sets the stage for the final fight of the deities. The boss for it, while not too harmful, is incredibly durable and is surrounded by your typical police force. But note! It costs $7,500 to enter, with a $20,000 payout if you win.

New Boss: Reality Deity
Featured in Reality Shift
After defeating the other deities of Mayhem, destroying countless asteroids and defying the law, you must now overcome the Reality Deity. You must destroy this to pass Reality Shift and destroy the S.E.S once and for all.  

New Mini-Boss: Frozen Residual
Featured in Reality Shift
Orbiting Reality Deity is a residual of the frozen deity. On impact, your engines will be disabled, with the only way of moving being using your boost! This deity also shoots a frozen icicle every 25 seconds so prioritise killing this one off before anything else. 

New Mini-Boss: Volcanic Residual
Featured in Reality Shift
Orbiting Reality Deity is a residual of the volcanic deity. On impact, you will lose a significant 2 lives, so be warned!

Reward Changes

 Classic Normal 250 -> 350
 Classic Mayhem 500 -> 750

 Most Wanted: Normal 500 -> 1000

notes.title: Patch 16.52 - Boss Improvements
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Minor update here, which brings an improved experimental stage to the boss fights which more information is shown below.

Boss Fights: Mini-Stage
Ever wondered why the frozen deity had a little line in the health bar? It's because I always had the idea of the boss fight getting a bit harder for the final push against it but never implemented it. With this update, both bosses now have this line and they both have a purpose! When the Volcanic reaches this line, it gains a speed boost of 50% meaning you'll need to utilise your plasma field. When the Frozen reaches this line, it gains a firing boost of 30% while also getting a movement debuff, so you'll need to evade bullets even better.

notes.title: Patch 16.5 - New and Improved Achievements
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Today's update overhauls how achievements work, removing and improving many of the existing ones as well as including new ones. One example is that previously with the "Reach Player Level 50", you had to go to stats to unlock it, which isn't practical to new players. This update allows you to constantly unlock achievements such as these as well as others while playing, removing the need to follow such specific unlock conditions.

I've also removed a few of the spammy, easy to get achievements such as one practically awarding you for pressing play and replaced them with more fulfilling ones you have to work towards!

In total this update brings:
 10 new achievements
 16 improved achievements

And the best part is for all these overhauled achievements that previously existed, they'll automatically unlock upon launch! I hope to add a few more next update but for now that is all.

Thanks for supporting the game and myself,
Sep

notes.title: Combat Update | Patch #16
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This update includes 2 brand new abilities for your disposal against the mindless asteroids or the sentient battleships. Burst through their defences with rapid fire, dodge their attacks in slow motion, or just collect the plenty new achievements! 

Progressive Achievements
After a lot of tinkering with the Steamworks API and achievement system, I've finally managed to add progressive stat achievements. This means that I can include long-term achievements such as "Win 10 games in total" with ease and all you have to do is play and not mess with any save system! I'm still learning the best ways to make use of this but for now, I've added 11 new achievements for completionists, giving you more to do than ever. 

New Ability: Fast Reflex
Available in: Classic, Most Wanted
Introducing Fast Reflex, an ability which slows down time for 2 seconds, allowing you to dodge incoming asteroids with no problems. Everything else slows down, while you remain faster than the enemies, with a low cooldown of 15s!

New Ability: Heavy Barrel
Available in: Classic, Most Wanted
Also with this update comes Heavy Barrel, an ability which doubles your firing speed for 2 seconds, giving you the opportunity to destroy enemies in quick succession. The trade off is that this ability has a cooldown of 45s, so use it only when you need it.

Patch Notes
New
 Added 11 Achievements
 Added Fast Reflex ability
 Added Heavy Barrel abilityChanges

 Updated Controls ListFixes
 Fixed Repair Bar on Mayhem not working correctly


Regarding Search and Destroy
After playing some Search and Destroy for a while, as it has been neglected since I created it, I've come to realise that honestly, its boring as hell compared to the other options, with the only reason to play it for achievements. Therefore, this update removes the mode and achievements that come with it. The gamemode may be added back in the future, or replaced with a new idea, but for now it will remain empty.

notes.title: Patch 15.5 - New Mechanic, Normal Mode, Boss Grace Period
notes.notes:
Hi all,

It's been a long 4 months since the last productive patch but I deliver some good news, Patch 15.5! This patch brings back Normal mode for Classic, with (hopefully) all boss fight bugs that existed, fixed! I also bring a QoL feature to make boss fights more bearable and a new mechanic! Hope you enjoy. 

Boss Spawn Protection
The most requested feature I've had is to fix the volcanic deity practically spawning on you and instantly ruining your run. With this update, I've finally done some tweaks to make this issue, no longer an issue. From now on, you will get a 1.5s invincibility protection at the start of a boss fight and a higher chance for the boss to spawn further away. There may be issues caused by this but if there are, I'll sort them out. I hope this makes the game more enjoyable! 

Visibility Beacon
Available in: Classic, Most Wanted, Search and Destroy
Your ship has now been equipped with a new upgrade! Featuring the Beacon, no longer needing to linger in the dark, you can take on asteroids or enemies with full awareness! Press "N" to activate the new feature, but be warned, you'll lose 60% speed when turned on. Is the trade off worth it late game?

Hi all,

This update introduces Discord rich presence, just like the one I implemented for Steam. Although it's pretty much useless for a small indie game and doesn't offer any benefits, it's mainly implemented for my own practice and learning of development skills. 

This allows your friends to see what mode you are playing as well as even being able to see your wallet amount in the Locker or how much you're making in Money Clicker!

https://i.imgur.com/62jQSyc.png

This update also temporarily disables Normal mode of the base asteroid mode until further notice. Despite using the exact same code as Mayhem, and working for so long with no issues, there's an issue that prevents progression past Level 2. During testing on the Unity project, I can progress past Level 2 with no problems. But on Steam, there's an issue that may be down to the Steam Client backend, which will require further investigating. Until then, Mayhem is still optional and all other gamemodes will progress as normal. 

I thank you all for showing support for my game however!

notes.title: Red Light, Green Light | Patch #15
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This patch features a new mode for you to play, earn achievements and unlock cosmetics! 

Red Light, Green Light: Normal
Playable in Arcade
Rewards: $25
This new mode is made from the classic children's game, Red Light Green Light. Your goal is to sneak past the S.E.S Brute without being caught. When the brute is faced away, make your way past him slowly. On random intervals, he will turn around and scan for movement. If you move, you die. After 75 seconds have passed, your ship's stealth system will run out of energy, leading to imminent death. Can you race against the clock to escape?

Red Light, Green Light: Time Trial
Playable in Arcade
Rewards: $75
Collect all 3 energy crystals and get past the Brute within 75 seconds to secure victory. If you do not collect all of them and escape, you'll only receive $25.

Achievement Update
As I'm limited to 100 achievements, and I keep adding new modes + enemies that I want to dedicate achievements to, I'm continuing my plan of flushing out the old achievements. Not all of them will be removed and replaced, but many of the extremely easy ones with the old icons will be eventually replaced with better and newer ones reflecting the new modes.

notes.title: The Most Wanted Update | Patch #13
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This patch features a new mode for you to all experiment with. Please note that this new mode will need EXTENSIVE testing, trial and error, before it’s fully suitable and completed. This is my first time making an enemy AI like this before which chases to close range, shoots and more, meaning that it may seem too strong or weak at times.

New Mode: Most Wanted
Playable in Arcade
Rewards: 30XP
The Space Enforcement Service (SES) patrols and protects all parts of space from planet damage to unusual activity. After witnessing you destroying thousands of asteroids when you were stranded, you have made yourself a high-risk suspect, which needs destroying. In this mode, cornered by agents of the SES, your primary objective is to survive 3 minutes until your nuclear bomb is ready and discharge it, clearing a path to escape. Take out waves of SWAT teams, siphon health from enemy ships, and do whatever it takes to survive. 

Most Wanted's Wave System
Most Wanted adapts a new wave system which is utilised with the base spawning system used with the asteroids. While normal SES officers will spawn with the old system, other variants of enemies will spawn at dedicated times throughout the 3 minutes. Below are all the timings. 
 3x SES Patrol Officers spawn every 3 seconds
 5x SES SWAT Officers spawn every 30 seconds
 1x SES CQ Specialist spawns every 15 seconds
 1x SES Brute spawns at the 2 minute mark

New Enemy: SES Patrol Officer
Patrol officers are the base enemy you'll spend the majority of time fighting against. They move slightly slower than the player, have a range of 9m, and deals 1 damage per 2 seconds. They are a one-bullet kill.

New Enemy: SES SWAT Officer
SWAT officers arrive every 30 seconds as a group and will be a pain against if you've let too many patrol officers swarm the area. They move a bit slower compared to the Patrol Officers, have a range of 11m, and deals 1 damage per 1 second. They are a one-bullet kill.

New Enemy: SES CQ Specialist
Close-quarters specialists deal devastating damage up close and are fast. They move slightly faster than the player, have a range of 2m, and deals 5 damage per second. They are a one-bullet kill.

New Enemy: SES Brute
The Brute is the toughest officer to go against. They move extremely slowly, however have a range of 10m, and deals 10 damage per second. They are a ten-bullet kill.

notes.title: [BETA] Rescue Operations: Part 1 | Patch #11
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Patch 11 marks the new mode which will be my priority, Arcade! Arcade overall will consist of various minigames. However, with this, comes a lot of testing that will need doing before being marked as complete! Each gamemode will require fresh and different movement mechanics, camera control and core changes. Not only will this cause bugs, but also take longer for updates as this is all new to me and a learning experience. Below, I'll explain more of what this means for Rocky Mayhem. 

How will updates come out from now?
For each full numbered patch, will come a brand new mode to Arcade. For Patch 11, this is Rescue Operations. The first patch for each mode will feature early playtest levels, with barebone features and repeated maps. The purpose of this is to test if the gameplay has potential to be fun, or if it should be scrapped. This also allows me to test different ways of executing the new modes. 

For every new map, change, or rework, the patch numbers will be in decimal numbers. So for example, Patch 11.1 will feature new changes or maps for Rescue Operations, so on. It'll make more sense as modes come out. Once I'm done with Rescue Operations and I'm satisfied with the content, there will be an announcement for it's completion and we will move onto Patch 12, which will be an entirely new mode. I hope this will make sense eventually!

New Mode: Rescue Operations
Featured in: Arcade
Taking the role as a Space Ambulance for the Ship Rescue and Recovery Service (SRRS), your duty is to locate and charge up powerless drilling ships and their pilots from the depths of planets. Do you have what it takes to be a rescue operator?

Obviously, thank you so much to those who have played, finished and reviewed the game. I am extremely grateful, and the game has even reached 20 concurrent players which is a major achievement to me. In terms of gameplay wise, I've added everything I want to for the current survival mode. The idea of a story mode or co-op mode is still in the air so bare with me.

One thing I want to do is achievements. Unfortunately until the game gets more reviews, Steam has capped me at 100 achievements so the ideas I have for so many new ones cannot go ahead. As soon as this changes, you can expect a patch of up to 100-250 new achievements, with some achievements related to the new statistic system I implemented. Until that is added, I cannot think of adding any new content, especially with 90% of the playerbase playing for achievements. Surprise! Early Release!

LIGHTS OUT
To celebrate the end of the 4 year early access period, I present Rocky Mayhem: Lights Out! This update brings atmospheric lighting, manual repairing mechanic, two new weapons, new gameplay changes and many fixes. Experience Rocky Mayhem in a new light, or lack of light that is, and destroy asteroids in a revamped fashion!

Customisation
Use Skin Code 'supporter' to unlock 2 skins, available until 24th June, 5pm BST 
Lights Out brings a new feature I've been working on, customisation! You will now be able to unlock and equip skins from playing, and best part is that once you unlock them, you keep them! Featuring 21 skins on launch, as well as a seasonal skin which changes every season, there are plenty of options to choose from. More skins will come after launch, and there will also be exclusive codes you can enter to redeem skins. Which one is right above!

New Ability: Incinerating Beam
Introducing the highest-tech weapon the gunship has ever received. This beam demolishes everything in it's path, allowing you to dominate the battlefield. However with such a great advantage of 7 seconds of devastating power, comes a long recharge cycle of 1 minute 40 seconds. With this, and the recoil the weapon gives, can you handle it?

New Deployable: Plasma Field
Replacing the Energy Ball comes it's upgraded static version, the Plasma Field. The field is a circle which sits in your ship's current position, destroying and repelling any asteroid to come into distance. This device can last up to 10 seconds or it can be damaged beyond repair after 6 asteroids collide with it. The recharge cycle is 25 seconds.

New Mechanic: Manual Repair
Replacing the basic health pickups comes manual repairing! With the manual repair mechanic, you start the game with 3 repair torches in your inventory. To use one, click "R" to fill up the bar in the bottom left. Once filled, the ship will deplete that torch and regain 25HP.

notes.title: Anti-Cheat Update
notes.notes:
Hi all.

Recently since I introduced steam achievements, I've seen a few users using an auto-clicker to unlock many achievements. This disappoints me because Steam Achievements were implemented for the community to challenge each other and see who could achieve the most achievements. Therefore I introduce...

Built-In Anti-Cheat
While not flawless, this basic anti cheat will detect an unusual amount of consistant clicks per second over a certain timespan. If detected, a window will pop-up alerting you that an auto-clicker was detected and achievements will be disabled. The only way to fix this is restarting your game and disabling your auto-clicker. This is one I coded in myself so if there's any unjustified disabling of achievements, please link me a video of you playing and I'll review it myself.

I hope this will solve the problems of auto-clicking to cheat achievements!

Hey guys! Thanks for visiting our page, it's an honour to have you here. It's my first game so I'm still getting used to the Steam interface, bare with me. Added Chapter 2.5 Expansion Content
